structure: Part 8 read, at commit c2078fb, the four DR2.1 views roles-and-addresses.html (157 lines), consignment-address-select.html (216), consignment-add-address.html (163) and contact-address-for-consignment.html (105); the four DR2.1 partials consignment-manual-address-fields, consignment-uk-add-address-fields (the three-step postcode lookup), consignment-uk-contact-fields and consignment-uk-manual-address-fields; the data files consignment-address-sections.js (7 sections, commodity-code section lists), consignment-address-use-groups.js, consignment-addresses.js (36 seeded addresses), contact-addresses.js (3 branch addresses) and address-book-lookup-addresses.js (500 generated UK and EU lookup addresses plus 80 Northern Ireland ones); and app/routes.js lines 1428-1581, 2739-2875, 2890-3118, 3672-3691, 4369-5011, 11222-11296, 11335-11357, 14507-14546 and 15043-15139. To follow behaviour the ranges call, it also read routes.js 36-56, 93-95, 310-349, 1720-1824 (journey steps and save redirects), 5768-5788, 6045-6072, 7685-7716, 11143-11151, 11358-11432 (saveAddressBookEntry), 11830-11845, 11979-11995 and 12029-12067 (validateAddressBookManualAddress), the shared partial journey-form-actions.html, app/data/address-book-origin-uses.js and address-book-destination-uses.js, and app/assets/javascripts/consignment-address-search.js. Pages covered: the consignment addresses summary at /roles-and-addresses (caption Addresses, every section row, change, add, same-as copy and remove actions, success banner, buttons and where they lead); the five generated section select pages (/place-of-origin, /consignor-or-exporter, /consignee, /importer, /place-of-destination) with search, results table, seeded data, buttons and the missing no-selection error; the five generated <section>/add-address pages with the manual branch (origin side) and the UK postcode lookup branch (destination side: postcode, results and details steps), address-use checkboxes, every validation message and the save actions; and /contact-address-for-consignment, which DR2.1 redirects to the review page and leaves out of the journey and hub, though the page, its radios, validation and buttons are still routed for other versions. The postcode find-address pages that front the lookup add-address pages, the CPH and permanent address pages, and the address book pages are other parts'.

Any other commodity code, or no code, shows the five address sections plus the CPH number section by default.
